pencereler.0-5: Before dawn, a regional jet ran off the end of a runway in Kentucky.
pencereler.5-12: It crashed into trees, and forty nine people were killed. It had lined up on the wrong runway. That
pencereler.12-20: runway was short and unlit. Construction had changed the usual taxi route. Neither pilot noticed the heading didn't match. The jet couldn't
pencereler.20-30: lift off in time. Runway-confirmation checks were strengthened afterward.

segmentler.metin: Comair Flight 5191 crashed after taking off from a runway far too short.
It took only a turn onto the wrong runway in the dark.
So how could a turn onto the wrong runway in the dark do this?
The answer is take-off from a short, unlit general-aviation runway instead of the assigned runway — and it is why runway-confirmation procedures and cockpit moving-map displays were promoted.
